system.description:
You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability. The target regains 2d10+10 hit points. For the duration of the jutsu, the target regains 10 hit point at the start of each of its turns so long as you end your movement adjacent to that creature.

The targets severed body members (fingers, legs, tails, and so on), if any, are restored so long as you remained in contact for the dull duration. If you have the severed part and hold it to the stump, the jutsu instantly causes the limb to knit to the stump.
